source: 612 Daybreak
target: 612 Diluculum

source: “Omebella.”
target: “Omebella.”

source: Termiboros’s resonant voice reverberated in Lumian’s ears as He echoed Lugano’s words.
target: Vox resonans Termiboris in auribus Luminiani resonabat, dum verba Lugano iterabat.

source: “You’ve heard of that?” Lumian hadn’t anticipated Termiboros, who had maintained silence for a considerable time, mentioning a name that left no impression on him.
target: “Audivistine id?” Non exspectavit Lumian Termiboros, qui diu silentium servaverat, nomen proferre, quod nullam impressionem in eum reliquit.

source: No, I’ve never heard of it before today.
target: Non, numquam ante hunc diem id audīvī.

source: Lugano thought it was a question directed at him.
target: Lugano putāvit hanc quaestiōnem ad se directam esse.

source: Termiboros fell silent, offering no response.
target: Termiboros tacuit, nec responsum dedit.

source: From the looks of it, it seems there is something off about the Child of God’s true name…
target: Ex specie, vidētur aliquid non conveniens esse in verō nomine Fīliī Deī…

source: And it sounds like a woman’s name.
target: Et sonat ut nomen muliebre.

source: Considering the Villain pathway’s progression to Sequence 5 Banshee, where they transition to women, and the inherent female inclination of the Earth pathway’s Sequence 0, Earth Mother, along with the influence of the Great Mother Herself, it’s quite plausible that the Child of God is a woman.
target: Consideratis progressionibus viae Malefici ad Sequenciam 5 Banshee, in qua ad feminas convertuntur, et indole naturalis itineris Terrae Sequenciae 0, Mater Terrae, necnon cum influentia ipsius Magna Matris, satis verisimile est Filia Dei esse.

source: It’s a logical deduction…
target: Est conclusio logica…

source: Lumian glanced at Lugano and smiled.
target: Lumian Lugano aspexit et subridens fuit.

source: “It’s fortunate you weren’t aware of this earlier.
target: “Felix es quod hoc prius nesciebas.

source: Otherwise, you might have found yourself linked to the so‐called Child of God.”
target: Alioquin te cum quodam Filia Dei coniunxisses.”

source: As Lumian spoke, his attention shifted to Ludwig, who had silently moved to the living room’s balcony.
target: Dum Lumian loquebatur, attentio eius ad Ludovicum versa est, qui tacite in balconem salonis se contulit.

source: Lumian approached him at a measured pace, his gaze following Ludwig’s toward the deck where Captain Pedro and others were examining Father Montserrat’s lifeless form.
target: Lumian ad eum accessit gradu moderato, oculis Ludovici secutis versus tabulatum, ubi Capitaneus Pedro et alii corpus Patris Montserrat mortuum inspexerunt.

source: Lumian asked thoughtfully, “Is it edible?”
target: Lumian meditabundus quaesivit: “Estne id comestibile?”

source: He meant whether Father Montserrat’s corpse was edible.
target: Intendebat utrum corpus Patris Montserrat comestibile esset.

source: While Lumian had abstained from claiming the Church of Earth Mother’s possessions, including Father Montserrat’s Beyonder characteristics, he hadn’t committed to preserving the corpse intact.
target: Dum Lumian abstinuit postulare possessiones Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, inter quas propriae facultates Beyonder Patris Montserrat includebantur, non sē obligavit corpus integerrimum servare.

source: In the heat of battle, it was customary for bodies to sustain damage!
target: In calore pugnae, mos erat ut corpora laesione affecta essent!

source: Ludwig shook his head.
target: Ludwig caput quassavit.

source: “Not yet.”
target: “Nondum.”

source: “Very well,” Lumian sighed, retracting his gaze with a tinge of regret.
target: “Valde bene,” inquit Lumian suspirans, oculos retrahens cum aliquo paenitentiae dolore.

source: Thus, the mystery of Father Montserrat’s inexplicable connection with the invisible Child of God remained unsolved.
target: Ita, mysterium nexūs inexplicabilis Patris Montserrat cum invisibili Filia Dei manebat nondum resolutum.

source: A peculiar umbilical cord had even taken root in his stomach, leaving Lumian unable to confirm if Prinpino was a byproduct refined from Father Montserrat’s remains.
target: Funiculus umbilicalis insolitus etiam in ventre eius radicatus erat, relinquens Lumian certiorem esse utrum Prinpino ex reliquiis Patris Montserrat elaboratus esset.

source: Indeed, Father Montserrat bore signs of severe corruption, though Lumian hadn’t anticipated his corruption to rival that of Mad Lady’s.
target: Certe, Patris Montserrat signa corruptionis gravis ostendebat, quamquam Lumian eius corruptionem non praevidit ut aequipolleret corruptioni Dominae Insanae.

source: Of course, it paled in comparison to the state of the Mad Lady’s corpse; even Ludwig found it too dirty.
target: Certe, illud in comparatione ad statum cadaveris Dominae Insanae palluit; et Ludwig id nimis sordidum putavit.

source: As for spirit channeling, Lumian understood that a spirit banished by the Exorcism Spell couldn’t be summoned for a specific duration, rendering communication impossible.
target: Quoad canalizationem spirituum, Lumian intellexit spiritum, quo incantatione exorcismi expulsum erat, per certam tempus evocari non posse, communicationem impossibile reddi.

source: Once this period lapsed, spirit channeling became futile.
target: Postquam hoc tempus lapsum est, canalizatio spirituum vana facta est.

source: Upon returning to the living room, Lumian sank into a recliner, casually unbuttoning his black vest and linen shirt.
target: Rediens ad conclave, Lumian in lectum reclinavit, vestem nigrum et tunicam linteam dissolvens.

source: Turning to Lugano, he remarked, “Come and treat me.”
target: Conversus ad Lugano, inquit: “Veni et me curare!”

source: Lugano’s eyes surveyed the makeshift bandages and the oozing wounds, expressing surprise.
target: Oculi Lugani inspexerunt fascias improvisas et vulnera exsudantia, stuporem ostendentes.

source: “It’s that serious?”
target: “Estne ita grave?”

source: Lumian, with a hint of amusement, responded, “Do you think dealing with Father Montserrat is a walk in the park?”
target: Lumian, leviter subridens, respondit: “Putasne agere cum Patre Montserrat rem tam facile esse, ut ambulatio in horto?”

source: “If I hadn’t taken risks, I might have been the one lying dead.”
target: “Si pericula non cepissem, forsitan ego mortuus iacerer.”

source: Lugano instinctively denied the suggestion, “Not what I meant.”
target: Lugano instinctive respondit: “Non hoc intendebam.”

source: “Why are your clothes and pants unscathed after such serious injuries?”
target: “Cur vestimenta et bracae tuae post tam graves vulnera intactae sunt?”

source: Lumian, enduring the pain, replied casually, “I obviously changed before coming back.”
target: Lumian, dolorem ferens, respondit leviter: “Plane mutavi me antequam redierim.”

source: His Traveler’s Bag proved invaluable, holding nearly a dozen identical shirts, vests, and pants, albeit varying in vest colors.
target: Saccus Viatoris eius praestabat, continens fere duodecim tunicas, vestes, et bracas identicas, quamquam vestium coloribus variabantibus.

source: The only casualty was the golden straw hat, consumed in the explosion, now burnt to ashes.
target: Unica laesa res fuit pileus stramineus aureus, consumptus in explosione, nunc in cineres redactus.

source: However, this setback hardly fazed the great adventurer, Louis Berry, who had stocked up on identical replacements before leaving Port Farim.
target: Attamen, hoc casus vix moverat magnum adventorem, Ludovicum Berry, qui ante discessum Port Farim supplentes identicos congregaverat.

source: This was the benefit of having a Traveler’s Bag.
target: Hoc erat commodum habendi saccum viatoris.

source: Otherwise, how could he have the space to store so many useless items with just a suitcase?
target: Alioquin, quomodo potuisset spatium habere ad tot res inutiles reponendas, nisi in sola capsula?

source: Lugano, choosing not to pry further, focused on tending to his employer’s injuries.
target: Lugano, non ultra inquirere optans, incumbit curae vulnerum patroni sui.

source: Originally considering a more intricate procedure, like cutting off charred skin, Lugano’s plans were halted by Lumian, opting for a simpler approach.
target: Consilia Lugani, quae primum de procedūra magis intricāta (ut cutem ustulātam excidendum) versabantur, ab Lumiano interclusa sunt, simpliciorem viam eligens.

source: Lumian had no intention of enduring the agony of anesthesia‐free surgery, knowing that he would revert to his original state at 6 a.m.
target: Lumian non intendebat cruciatum chirurgiae sine anesthesiā pati, sciens se ad statum suum originalem ad horam sextam rediurum esse.

source: With the pain and injuries now manageable and showing significant improvement, Lumian made his way back to his room.
target: Cum dolor et vulnera nunc tolerabilia atque notabiliter meliora viderentur, Lumian ad cameram suam rediit.

source: There, he unfolded a letter and began recounting the events involving Father Montserrat and the true name of the Child of God, diligently reporting to Madam Magician.
target: Ibi epistulam explicavit et eventūs, qui Patris Montserrat et verī nominis Filiae Dei attinebant, enarrāre coepit, diligenter ad Magistram Magicam referens.

source: Lumian consistently regarded matters related to evil gods and the so‐called Child of God with great gravity.
target: Lumian constanter negotia, quae ad deos malos et ad quodam Filiae Dei spectabant, graviter considerabat.

source: He believed such concerns should be left to his superiors, acknowledging the importance of involving higher authorities.
target: Existimabat talia negotia ad superiores relinquenda esse, momentum autem auctoritatum superiorum agnoscens.

source: Had Mr. K possessed a messenger, Lumian would have promptly dispatched a modified copy to inform the Aurora Order Oracle of the situation.
target: Si Dominus K nuntium haberet, Lumian celeriter exemplar emendatum misisset ad Oraculum Ordinis Aurorae de re informandum.

source: The next course of action wasn’t within the purview of an ordinary member like him or Minor Arcana; it was a concern for others to address.
target: Proximum consilium non pertinebat membris ordinariīs ut ipse aut Minor Arcana; illa cura aliorum erat.

source: Observing a shared stance between the Tarot Club and the Aurora Order in combating evil gods, especially those breaching the barrier, Lumian recognized his responsibility as both a minor Arcana card holder in the Tarot Club and an official member of the Aurora Order.
target: Observans stantiam mutuam inter Clubum Taroticum et Ordinem Aurorae in deos malos—praecipue eos qui claustra violabantur—Lumian onus suum agnovit tamquam possessor chartārum Minor Arcana in Clubo Tarotico et membrum officiale Ordinis Aurorae.

source: After meticulously recording the details, including Termiboros’s reaction, Lumian summoned the “doll” messenger.
target: Postquam singula diligenter recensita sunt, inter quae reactio Termiboris, Lumian nuntium “pupulam” convocavit.

source: Engaged in a recent dispute with Ludwig and being in proximity to the other party, the “doll” messenger swiftly arrived and departed.
target: Inter recentem discordiam cum Ludovico implicatus et in propinquitate alterius versans, nuntius “pupula” celeriter advenit atque discessit.

source: It seldom lingered, avoiding casual conversations.
target: Raro morabatur, vitans colloquia levia.

source: In a clean and refreshing bedroom of Loen Kingdom, Backlund, Madam Magician lay peacefully in bed, immersed in a restful slumber.
target: In conclāvō pūrō et refrigeriōsō regnī Loen, Backlund, Magistra Magica, pacate in lectō iacebat, sopore quietō immersa.

source: Abruptly, she sat up, a puzzled expression crossing her face.
target: Subito, illa surrexit, vultū perplexō ornāta.

source: Spirituality warning?
target: Monitio spiritualis?

source: Is something significant about to unfold?
target: Numquid res gravis exsistere parāta est?

source: Madam Magician, having just poured a glass of Sonia blood wine and not yet delved into her astromancy, was surprised to see the “doll” messenger materialize on her desk.
target: Magistra Magica, recenter poculum vini sanguinei Soniae effundens et astromanciam nondum exercēns, admirāta est quod nuntius “pupula” in mensā suā apparuisset.

source: It placed a folded letter next to a dark‐red fountain pen.
target: Iuxta calamum atramentārium rubrum, epistolam convolutam posuit.

source: Lumian’s letter…
target: Epistula Luminiani…

source: Has he unearthed the issue with the Earth Mother Church’s priest?
target: Num quaestiōnem sacerdōtis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae detexit?

source: I didn’t guide him in vain…
target: Non frustra eum duxī…

source: Madam Magician mused, letting the glass float in midair.
target: Magistra Magica meditāta est, poculum in aere leviter suspendēns.

source: She picked up the letter and unfolded it.
target: Illam epistolam sustulit et explicavit.

source: As she read, her expression underwent a sudden change, and she softly repeated the name,
target: Dum legebat, facies eius subito mutāta est, et leniter nomen repetivit,

source: “Omebella?”
target: “Omebella?”

source: The true name of the invisible Child of God is this?
target: Hocne verum nomen Filiae Dei invisibilis est?

source: Was my spiritual warning connected to it?
target: Num mea monitio spiritualis ad hoc pertinuit?

source: This is something worth discussing at the Tarot Club’s regular gathering…
target: Hoc est aliquid quod apud conventum ordinārium Clubi Taroticī disserendum est…

source: After a moment, Madam Magician used astromancy to indirectly verify the information.
target: Post aliquod tempus, Magistra Magica astromantiam ad informationem indirectē verificandam usus est.

source: She then seated herself and observed as the dark‐red fountain pen levitated.
target: Deinde sese sedavit et observavit dum calamus atramentārius ruber levitabatur.

source: Removing the cap, she began to inscribe her thoughts on the faux goatskin: “Omebella is a name shrouded in the fog of history. It carries a potent symbolic meaning in mysticism…”
target: Caput removēns, coepit suas cogitātiōnēs in fictam pelle caprina inscribere: “Omebella nomen est caligine historiae involūtum. Potentem significationem symbolicam in mysteriīs gerit…”

source: “Using Omebella as the Child of God’s true name. I don’t know if it’s tied to the mysteries of the Second Epoch when the ancient gods, predating the Ancient Sun God, ruled the land, or if the Great Mother is employing intense mystical symbolism to gradually erode Earth Mother’s authority and even Earth Mother Herself.
target: “Utendo Omebella tanquam verum nomen Filiae Dei. Nescio an id ad arcāna Secundae Aetātis pertineat, cum antiquī dei, priores Deo Solis Antiquō, terram regebant, aut an Magna Mater intensam symbolicam mysticam ad auctoritatem Matris Terrae atque ipsam Maternem paulatim erodendam utātur.

source: If we can unravel the secrets of the ancient era, we might find an answer.
target: “Si arcāna aetātis antiquitātis explicare possimus, responsum inveniemus.

source: The one the Aurora Order believes in might know something.”
target: “Ille, quem Ordo Aurorae credit, fortasse aliquid sciat.”

source: As Lumian read the response inked on faux goatskin, he sensed a subtle suggestion from Madam Magician, hinting at him to inquire with the Aurora Order through Mr. K.
target: Dum Lumian responsum in ficta pelle caprina inscriptum legebat, subtilis admonitiōnem a Magistrā Magicā percipiebat, quae eum per Dominum K cum Ordine Aurorae interrogare incitabat.

source: He continued reading.
target: Continuavit legendum.

source: “Simply put, Omebella belongs to the ancient giant race.
target: “Simpliciter, Omebella genti gigantēā antiqua pertinet.

source: Once known as the Goddess of Harvest during the era when ancient gods held sway.
target: Olim, ut Dea Messis, nota erat, tempore quo antiquī dei terram regebant.

source: I can’t divulge more at this time.
target: Nunc amplius enarrāre non possum.

source: No need to delve into this matter specifically.
target: Non opus est hanc rem peculiārē examinare.

source: If you come across the Earth Mother Church’s Favored, Nightstalkers, or members of the School of God’s Descent, keep a vigilant eye.
target: Si occurrerint Favorītī Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, Nocturnī aut membra Scholae Dei Descendentis, oculōs vigilantes tene.

source: We’ll handle the follow‐up.
target: Sequentes res nos curābimus.

source: Of course, when the time comes, we might assign you one or two minor missions.”
target: Scilicet, cum tempus venerit, tibi unam vel duas missionēs minōrēs delegare possumus.”

source: The Goddess of Harvest… indeed linked to the Earth pathway… Lumian pondered as he burned the letter with crimson flames.
target: Dea Messis… certe ad viam Terrae conjuncta… meditātus est Lumian, dum epistolam flammas rubras incendebat.

source: Returning to bed, he feigned sleep, attuned to the ship’s movements.
target: Rediens ad lectum, somnum simulāvit, motibus navis attendēns.

source: With the sunrise, his body swiftly healed, and the day unfolded without unexpected incidents.
target: Cum sol oriebātur, corpus celeriter sanātum est, et diēs sine inopinātīs casibus evolūtus est.

source: Lumian returned to the living room and addressed Lugano, who had been awake for an hour, showing signs of a restless night.
target: Lumian ad conclāve rediit et Lugano alloquēns, quī per hōram vigilāverat, vestigiā noctis incommodae ostendēns.

source: “Still hearing the baby crying?”
target: “Audisne adhuc infanti plorantem?”

source: “No,” Lugano replied, a mix of joy and uncertainty evident in his response.
target: “Non,” respondit Lugano, ubi mixtio laetitiāe et dubiātiōnis in responso eius patebat.

source: Lugano believed he needed more time to observe before drawing a final conclusion.
target: Lugano putāvit se plūra tempora observāre oportēre antequam ultimam conclūsiōnem traheret.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subrīdēns risit.

source: “As expected, seeking Father Montserrat’s help is the only way to completely resolve your aftereffects.”
target: “Ut exspectātum est, auxilium Patris Montserrat quaerere sola via est ad effecta tua postea omnīnō solvendō.”

source: Lugano nearly choked on his words.
target: Lugano paene verbīs se suffocāvit.

source: So, that’s why you wanted me to seek help from Father Montserrat?
target: Itaque, hoc est quod voluīstī ut auxilium a Patre Montserrat quaererem?

source: Killing him is the equivalent of completely resolving the aftereffects I suffered?
target: Num interficere eum aequipollet effectibus meīs postea omnīnō solvendīs?

source: Lumian approached the balcony and instructed Lugano, “Find Enio later and use a follow‐up consultation as an excuse to confirm his condition.”
target: Lumian ad balconem accessit et Lugano inseverat: “Postea Enion invenias et consultatione subsequenti utere ut statum eius comprobes.”

source: Right, Enio was saved by Father Montserrat’s surgery.
target: Recte, Enio operatione Patris Montserrat servātus est.

source: Since there’s something wrong with Father Montserrat, he, too, might be problematic…
target: Cum quid de Patre Montserrat vitiosum sit, ipse quoque fortasse problematicus erit…

source: Lugano had concerns seeking the patient, fearing potential danger.
target: Lugano sollicitūdinem habebat quaerendo aegrotum, metuens periculum potentiale.

source: However, as he observed the sunlight gradually brightening and the horizon turning red, a sense of relief washed over him.
target: Attamen, dum paulatim solem fulgentem et horizontem rubescente observābat, sensus levātiōnis eum invasit.

source: At 9 a.m., Lugano returned, informing Lumian that the special patient had recovered exceptionally well.
target: Hora novā ante meridiem, Lugano rediit et Lumian certiōrem fecit specialem aegrotum eximē bene convalescentem esse.

source: There were no signs of surgery failure or hidden dangers, nor indications of corruption.
target: Nullae erant indicia operationis clādīs aut periculōrum occultōrum, nec indicia corruptionis.

source: Around the same time, Captain Pedro approached Lumian, sharing news that the ship would temporarily dock to allow the Church of Earth Mother’s personnel to collect Father Montserrat’s corpse and relics and remove relevant individuals.
target: Circiter eodem tempore, Capitaneus Pedro ad Lumian accessit, nuntiāndo navem temporāriē ad studium ceponi collocandam destinārī, ut ministros Ecclesiae Matris Terrae cadaver Patris Montserrat et reliquiās colligerent atque personās pertinēntēs removerent.

source: Notably, the adventurer and his servant were explicitly excluded from this directive by the Church of Earth Mother.
target: Notabile est adventorem et servum eius ab Ecclesiā Matris Terrae expresse ex hoc praeceptō exceptōs esse.

source: Lumian smiled, offering no response to the captain’s words.
target: Lumian subrīdēns, verba capitānī non respondēns.

source: His demeanor radiated confidence and certainty.
target: Mōrēs eius fidūciam et certitūdinem efferebant.

source: Around noon, several combat nuns and a priest in a brown robe boarded the ship, escorting Enio and others away.
target: Circa meridiem, plures moniālēs pugnantēs et sacerdōs in vestī fuscā navem conscenderunt, Enion et alias comitantes ad sē ducēntes.

source: On the balcony, Lugano observed Enio being “invited” off the ship, his expression a mix of daze and fear, powerless to resist.
target: In balcone, Lugano observāvit Enion ex nave “invitārī”, vultū stupōre et metu mixtō, absque vi ad resistere.

source: Lugano sighed.
target: Lugano suspirāvit.

source: “If he’s fine, why capture him?”
target: “Si bene est, cur eum capere?”

source: Lumian emitted a soft chuckle.
target: Lumian leniter subrīdit.

source: “Do you think it’s nonexistent just because you say so?”
target: “Putesne id non exsistere solum quia ita dicis?”

source: “Be optimistic—after the Church of Earth Mother confirms there’s no issue, he might secure a clerical position within the Church, interacting with combat nuns daily.”
target: “Esto optimus—postquam Ecclesia Matris Terrae confirmāverit nullum esse problema, fortasse munus clericāle in Ecclesiā obtinebit, cotidie cum moniālīs pugnantibus intercedēns.”

source: Lugano fell silent, then after a few seconds, he remarked, “But that also means losing his freedom. He’s a victim…”
target: Lugano silevit, deinde post paucos secundōs remarkāvit: “Sed id etiam libertātem eius amittit. Victima est…”

source: “Freedom?” Lumian scoffed. “The prerequisite for freedom is not endangering others.”
target: “Libertās?” irridēns inquit Lumian. “Praerequisitum libertātis est, ut alīos non in periclīn adducantur.”

source: Despite his stance, as he witnessed the terrified and nervous Enio and recalled the deceased Father Montserrat in his normal persona, Lumian couldn’t help but recall a peculiar phrase his sister would occasionally utter: “All living beings suffer.”
target: Non obstante sua ratione, dum Enion territum et sollicitum videbat atque memoriam Patris Montserrat defunctī in forma ordināriā revocābat, Lumian non potuit quin mentem adferret peculīārem dictum, quod soror eius interdum utterābat: “Omnia viva patiuntur.”

source: Ooo!
target: Ooo!

source: With a whistle, the ship prepared to set sail once again.
target: Cum sibilō, navis iterum in navigandum parāta est.
